subject: Re: Kickoff: matrix compression for the serving fleet
body:
Zofia,

Staffing: Yusuf 70%, Linnea 50%, Emeka 60%. Compute: retraining the flagship model with compression ops in the graph costs roughly 1.3x a normal training run, so I am asking for 48 A100s on titan best-effort for the March and April training cycles.

One scoping addition. Automated metrics will not settle the rollout question - for the ranking model especially, we need humans judging whether compressed-model outputs actually degrade. To close that gap we are scoping and staffing a human-rating annotation UI, built from scratch: Emeka owns it end to end (rater queue, side-by-side comparison view, rating storage), with a working version by end of April. I am budgeting Emeka's 60% around it, plus a rater pool booked through the vendor program.

That makes the 4/17 curves milestone automated-metrics-only, with human ratings following by 5/8. Still compatible with your 5/15 recommendation date.

Deshawn
